title: Azure / sonic-mgmt repo: not able to run any test due to error
author: vaniramdurg
body: **Description** Azure/soni-mgmt repo while running test throws KeyError: 'asic_services' **Steps to reproduce the issue:** 1. Setup CEOS test bed as per the instructions in "https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/docs/testbed/README.testbed.VsSetup.md" 2. run the test as per instructions: "./run_tests.sh -n vms-kvm-t0 -d vlab-01 -c bgp/test_bgp_fact.py -f vtestbed.csv -i veos_vtb" **Describe the results you received:** -- Docs: https://docs.pytest.org/en/latest/warnings.html -------------------------------------------- generated xml file: /data/vanram/sonic-mgmt/tests/logs/pretest.xml --------------------------------------------- Traceback (most recent call last): File "/usr/lib/python2.7/logging/__init__.py", line 889, in emit stream.write(fs % msg) File "/usr/local/lib/python2.7/dist-packages/_pytest/capture.py", line 441, in write self.buffer.write(obj) ValueError: I/O operation on closed file Logged from file __init__.py, line 64 ================================================================== short test summary info ================================================================== FAILED autorestart/test_container_autorestart.py - KeyError: 'asic_services' FAILED container_checker/test_container_checker.py - KeyError: 'asic_services' FAILED memory_checker/test_memory_checker.py - KeyError: 'asic_services' !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! Interrupted: 3 errors during collection !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! ================================================== 2395 deselected, 24 warnings, 3 error in 10.41 seconds =================================================== !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! !!!!! Prepare DUT failed, skip testing !!!!! !!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! **Describe the results you expected:** **Additional information you deem important:** **Output of `show version`:** ``` (paste your output here) ``` **Attach debug file `sudo generate_dump`:** ``` (paste your output here) ```
